_schema: Open-item disposition tracker for the DSv4 roofline model. Every quantity is MODELED (derived, cite source), MEASURED (microbench), or EXPLICITLY-UNMODELED (declared + reason + plan, surfaced at review). No silent placeholders. Reviewed at each roofline revision.
reference_revision: DeepSeek-V4-Flash HF rev 60d8d70770c6776ff598c94bb586a859a38244f1 (config.json + inference/model.py + checkpoint-header dtypes)
invariant_selftest: REFERENCE-CONFORMANCE + reporting-contract checks that GATE report emission (python dsv4_roofline_p2.py --selftest): layer counts {0:2,4:21,128:20}, SUM_POS=16896, attn/hc_fn FLOPs, shared=FP8, routed=FP4, hc_fn=FP32, compressor capacity; plus single-point rendering (meas only at observed M), unmodeled renders no number, pool reads 2x FP32 state streams+APE, precision selects compute resource (FP32!=BF16 peak), strict fail-closed tracker validation (reference_revision + valid dispositions).

items.source: model.py: ONE sparse attention per layer over window(128)+compressed sources; positions/req summed over 43 main layers = SUM_POS=16896 (ratio-0->128, ratio-4->640, ratio-128->160); MQA flash, no score DRAM. Replaces prior full-S=4096 + separate top-512 pass
model.py Compressor: every-token projections now itemized — main r4 4096->2048 x21, main r128 4096->1024 x20, indexer r4 4096->512 x21 (BF16); capacity main=0.520GB + indexer=0.088GB
pool fires at (pos+1)%ratio==0; amortized calls/step = 21/4 + 20/128 = 5.40625 (main), 21/4 (indexer); ratio-4 overlap pools 2*ratio=8 positions, ratio-128 pools 128; D=512 main / D=128 indexer

pool reads BOTH FP32 state streams (kv + score, win*D each) + shared FP32 positional APE (win*D, once/call) and writes FP32 output (D/request); compressor projection GEMMs write FP32 state (act=fp32). Matches bench_compressor.py contract (kv,score,ape) at R=128,D=512 => 17,104,896 bytes @M=32

topk/sinkhorn/combine rendered ONLY at observed M=32 (N/A elsewhere), each with a benchmark source link; per-step aggregate = per-call observation x architectural invocation count (count modeled, latency observed), node pcl-sprh02 DDR5-5600

COMPUTE_PEAK maps bf16/fp8/fp4 to AMX 124.5TF and fp32 to AVX-512 7.78TF; FP32 MHC rows + crossings use the FP32 ceiling; hc_fn operand is FP32 (hc_pre casts). Self-test asserts a compute-bound FP32 GEMM is slower than BF16
checkpoint header F8_E4M3 w1/w2/w3 + F8_E8M0 scale => FP8 (0.5->1.0+1/16384 bpw); capacity=1.082GB. Routed experts remain MXFP4
model.py: K=hc_mult*H=16384 (not NH*HD=32768), N=(2+hc)*hc=24; checkpoint hc_attn_fn F32 => FP32; FLOP@M1=67633152
published model.py Block.hc_post; comb@residual bmm (2*HC^2*H) + post*x elementwise; 2x/layer; FP32 params
published model.py hc_head; linear(hc_fn[HC,HC*H])+weighted-sum, once; FP32

pilot microbenches (bench_indexer_logits.py / bench_sinkhorn.py / bench_combine.py) at grounded shapes; SINGLE observed coordinate M=32, node pcl-sprh02 DDR5-5600, rev 60d8d70770c6776ff598c94bb586a859a38244f1.
